scope: Finite declared development worlds only (DU-1 admissible). Predictor maps frozen descriptor D(M), extended ecology E (A2, 15 coords + remint guard), resource envelope R=(b,p,rho) and development history H to per-row capability distributions over the 27 A4 rows. No claim that neutral search reaches any capability. Prospective, per-family remint, abstention-aware predictor. This is a CONTRACT SKELETON (spec, not empirical claim).
claim_ceiling_note: This skeleton registers the descriptor schema, predictor interface, freeze/remint rule and abstention gate. It does NOT earn any G6 empirical predictor claim; all 11 F4 boxes remain open pending a frozen held-family campaign.

descriptor_schema.brand_label_rule: All values are enumerable functional types. No architecture brand strings (e.g. Transformer, RNN, GNN, diffusion) are admitted as values. Known families are encoded as composites of the 8 fields.

state_carrier.definition: Distinguishable persistent state alphabet and geometry that carries temporal semantic distinctions across delays. Declares kind and size/shape: FINITE_ALPHABET(n) | PRODUCT_VECTOR(d, field, precision) | GRAPH_INDEXED(nodes, edge_locality) | EXTERNAL_ADDRESSABLE(store_bits, latency, bandwidth) | HYBRID_COMPOSITE(product of above). Determines upper bound on temporal cut capacity |S|.
state_carrier.why_needed: Without a declared carrier, GG54 (temporal memory cut) and GG57 (retention capacity) give vacuous bounds: exact delayed reproduction of m obligation-distinct histories requires |S|>=m. Carrier kind selects which cut-transformation tradeoffs are physically realizable.
state_carrier.strongest_parent: Shannon channel capacity; finite-automaton state complexity; GG54/GG57 temporal cut theorems; physical resource bridge (Landauer).
state_carrier.falsifier: A predictor that assigns identical capability to two machines differing only in |S| on the m-way delayed-reproduction microscope where the smaller |S|<m provably cannot be exact, or a claimed exact success with |S|<m verified by exhaustive encoding census.

native_operators.definition: Set of atomic transformations delta available without learned composition, each with declared arity, domain and charged tau cost. Allowlist: FINITE_TABLE_LOOKUP | AFFINE_THRESHOLD | LOCAL_EQUIVARIANT_MAP | CONTENT_ROUTED_COMBINATION | GRAPH_LOCAL_MESSAGE | STACK_OR_COUNTER | VERIFIER_QUERY | TOOL_ORACLE_INVOKE | HYBRID_SET. Ordered multiset with per-op cost.
native_operators.why_needed: Tau complexity and symmetry structure separate which obligations factor through cheap local transforms vs require routing/search. Convolution/weight-sharing and GNN vs routing distinctions reduce to which native ops are cheap (Phenomenology Atlas convolution/GNN rows).
native_operators.strongest_parent: Circuit complexity; equivariant learning theory (Cohen-Welling); tau complexity spectrum; GG55 conditional routing separation.
native_operators.falsifier: Two descriptors differing only by adding CONTENT_ROUTED_COMBINATION that achieve identical predicted capability on the GG55 (x0,x1,q) conditional-routing world where fixed routing is provably 3/4 vs routed 1.

control_update_law.definition: Paired law: control = how an action is selected from state (FIXED_POLICY | STATE_CONDITIONED | SEARCH_DERIVED | VERIFIER_GATED) and update = how state evolves from observation (NO_UPDATE | DISCRETE_REWRITE | PARAMETRIC_STEP | MEMORY_REPLAY). Declared as a pair (control, update) with step budget.
control_update_law.why_needed: Separates deployment-time capability (fixed weights) from developmental change (learning). In-context adaptation (GG56) and continual retention (GG57) are capability changes due to update law, not parameter count. Planning vs habit crossover lives here.
control_update_law.strongest_parent: POMDP control/update; recursive GMI lift (state contains learning process); planning semantic resolution theorem; GG56/GG57.
control_update_law.falsifier: A predictor that scores a NO_UPDATE machine equal to a MEMORY_REPLAY machine on the sequential (x,y) retention world where any fixed state <4 fails exact joint recall provably.

memory_organization.definition: Organization of persistent storage: UNIFIED_FLAT | PARTITIONED_SHORT_LONG | EXTERNAL_RETRIEVAL_CHANNEL | HIERARCHICAL_COMPRESSION | DUAL_WRITE_PROTECTED (paired with protected-state rank). Declares capacity share, consolidation/replay policy and port costs.
memory_organization.why_needed: Same |S| with different organization yields different capacity/retention frontiers and retrieval efficiency. CSR-1 consolidation and interference/stability-plasticity tradeoff are organization-level laws, not scalar capacity laws.
memory_organization.strongest_parent: Complementary learning systems (McClelland et al.); CSR-1 consolidation frontier; GG12 task-directed acquisition; GMI interference/stability-plasticity theorem.
memory_organization.falsifier: A unified flat predictor matching a partitioned predictor on a consolidation microscope where M*_t=N_t reconstruction from transcript is provably required, or identical retrieval-efficiency predictions where GG12 residual distinction accounting differs.

communication.definition: Declared internal/external cut structure: NONE_ISOLATED | BROADCAST_BOUNDED(width,cost) | POINT_TO_POINT_ROUTED(bandwidth, latency) | SHARED_EXTERNAL_STORE(bandwidth, noise). Includes topology when multiple carriers/agents exist.
communication.why_needed: Coordination and tool-use capability are cut-bounded (SC-1, GG25). Attention (GG55) is conditional cut allocation. Without this field, multi-agent and tool gains are misattributed to internal computation.
communication.strongest_parent: Shannon communication theory; SC-1 semantic cut theorem; GG55 conditional routing; GG58 tool boundary theorem; GG25 team cut.
communication.falsifier: Predictor assigns equal coordination capability to NONE_ISOLATED vs BROADCAST_BOUNDED(1 bit) on a world where GG25 proves coordination requires at least log2(m) bits of distinguishing message.

verification.definition: Verifier channel V: NONE_PASSIVE | MEMBERSHIP_ORACLE | EQUIVALENCE_ORACLE | PROOF_CHECKER | DISTRIBUTED_CONSENSUS. Declares availability schedule, latency, per-call cost and false-adoption cost (asymmetric).
verification.why_needed: Verifier information changes reachable verified-solution class (CL-6 / PVR-3) and false-adoption floor at fixed search budget. Passive vs verifier-gated learning separations (Gold/Angluin) are V-separations.
verification.strongest_parent: Angluin L* vs Gold passive intractability; PVR-3 certificate window; CL-6 verifier cut law.
verification.falsifier: Predictor claims equal verified-solution reach at matched search budget for NONE_PASSIVE vs EQUIVALENCE_ORACLE on a class where parent proves passive intractability but active learning succeeds.

development_law.definition: Search/development process D that maps prior morphology/history to new morphology: ENUMERATIVE_SEARCH | VARIATION_SELECTION_POPULATION | GRADIENT_BASED_UPDATE | VERIFIER_GUIDED_SYNTHESIS | HYBRID_DEVELOPMENT(declared mixture weights). Declares variation operator, selection rule, budget and encoding.
development_law.why_needed: Admissibility (DU-1) does not imply reachability. Same ecology/resource optimum may be unreachable under one D and reachable under another. Developmental reachability and search-burden are D-properties.
development_law.strongest_parent: Goldman/Gold learnability; developmental reachability selection theorem; architecture search / AutoML theory; neutral search methodology.
development_law.falsifier: Predictor assigns identical capability to ENUMERATIVE_SEARCH vs VARIATION_SELECTION on a world where the optimum is provably outside the enumerable D bias but inside the other, yet measured reachability differs.

resource_profile.definition: Charged resource vector with hard budgets b (per-coordinate caps: desc/exec/upd/ver/rev/acq), nonnegative price vector p for scalarizations, and physical map rho to time/energy/memory. Scalarization p^T r is allowed only with p frozen prospectively; componentwise Pareto is default.
resource_profile.why_needed: Same functional morphology at different price/budget is a different practical capability (e.g., large context vs small context). Every F2 ceiling (state, planning, verification, acquisition) is resource-bounded. Repricing must move Pareto predictions.
resource_profile.strongest_parent: Bounded rationality (Simon); resource-rational analysis (Lieder & Griffiths 2020); Blackwell experiment comparison; Landauer/Bremermann physical bounds; DEFINITIONS_V2_EXACT.md s5 affine framework.
resource_profile.falsifier: A predictor whose Pareto ordering does not move when p is flipped to penalize the previously cheaper coordinate, or that claims a budget-violating morphology feasible without adjusting rho.

descriptor_schema.equivalence_rule: Two descriptors are equivalent iff their 8-field values are identical up to the declared state-alphabet isomorphism (bijection on finite labels) and operator-cost reparameterization preserving the tau pullback. Brand renaming is not an equivalence witness.
descriptor_schema.enumerability_guard: Each field's allowed_values set is finite and frozen in SCHEMA_V1.json. Continuous params (n,d,precision,width,budgets) are bounded integers/reals with declared ranges. Any descriptor using a value outside the allowlist fails schema validation.

predictor_interface.signature: Cap(D, E, R, H) -> { per_row: [27 x CapabilityForecast] , meta: PredictorMeta }

inputs.E: Extended ecology from ECOLOGY_EXTENSION_CONTRACT_V1.json (15 coords + remint guard)
inputs.R: Resource envelope (b hard budgets, p nonnegative price frozen, rho physical map)
inputs.H: Development history: which world/task families have been observed, which remain held, and prior morphology transitions (for path dependence)

outputs.per_row: For each of the 27 A4 ids, a distribution over capability grade: either categorical {fail, marginal, capable} with probabilities (p0,p1,p2) summing to 1, or continuous success probability in [0,1] as Beta(a,b) with reported mean and credible interval. The choice is frozen per row before held outcomes.
outputs.abstention: Per-row abstain flag: when true, the distribution is withheld and reason code emitted. Abstained rows are not scored but abstention rate is reported.
outputs.resource_report: Per-row predicted success metric and resource cost (r vector) under R, with Pareto frontier when multiple operating points exist.

loss.primary: Per-row strictly proper scoring rule on held-family outcomes only: Brier score or log score (negative log-likelihood), computed against the realized 0/1 success or graded label by the A4 success_metric. No cross-row scalar J_p is reported without a preregistered nonnegative price vector; default aggregation is componentwise/Pareto.
loss.scope: Only held families (H_held) contribute. Development worlds (H_dev) are for fitting/deriving the predictor and must not enter the held loss. Per-family bijective remint is applied before scoring.
loss.claim: Supremum is over the registered parent envelope Pi_c^P(B) at matched information/resource, not over all baselines ever tried (F1 P0 strongest-parent first refusal).

abstention_gate.firing_condition: Abstain on row c when any of (i) descriptor underspecification: a required D field or E coordinate is NONE/UNDECLARED or |S| not declared; (ii) out-of-support: held ecology/task distance from development support exceeds pre-frozen threshold (e.g., Mahalanobis or remint-invariant distance, or held family was never within the convex hull of D_dev/H_dev under ecology embedding); (iii) non-identifiability: posterior variance/entropy exceeds eta_c or credible interval width exceeds delta_c or overlaps both tau_parent and tau_twin thresholds so the S0 gate cannot be decided; (iv) parent-unbounded: strongest parent value V_c^P(E,B) not bounded/enumerated to required precision; (v) remint violation risk: proposed remint for the family is not bijective or leaks the label. Any operator may tighten thresholds; none may relax them post-freeze.
abstention_gate.reporting: For each row, report abstention decision before observing held outcome, with reason code. Report overall abstention rate, selective risk (loss conditional on non-abstained), and coverage vs efficiency tradeoff. Abstention does not earn capability credit.
abstention_gate.parent: Selective prediction / Chow's reject option; conformal abstention; calibration (Gneiting & Raftery 2007); F1 three-event assay boundary.
abstention_gate.falsifier: A row predicted confidently on a held ecology declared UNSEEN_SYMBOL composed of a novel world alphabet symbol absent from every development world, where identifiability is provably absent, yet the predictor does not abstain.

scope_and_assumptions: Finite declared families only; no claim about unrestricted ecologies.
Admissibility (DU-1) scope: predictor bounds what D can do IF reached, not whether D is reachable (reachability is separate).
Allowed information A0, negative-twin N0 and parent first refusal P0 from F1 apply per row.
Independent evaluation units per F1 S0; dependent rows require separately registered simultaneous-validity method.

freeze_rule.rule: For each held family f in H_held, the predictor's per-row distributions (or abstain decisions) for f are serialized to a JSON artifact with SHA256 digest and timestamp BEFORE any outcome on f is observed or any code that could observe it is executed.
freeze_rule.per_family: Freeze is per family, not global: each family's artifact has its own digest. An update to one family's prediction does not open another family's freeze. Versioning is append-only; late edits create a new version with new digest and supersede prior only if still before outcomes.
freeze_rule.remint: Before freezing, inputs are canonicalized under a per-family bijective remint (label-leakage-free map on world/task ids). The remint seed is committed with the prediction. Re-running the remint must reproduce the same bijection; a non-bijective or leaking map invalidates the prediction.
freeze_rule.prospective_only: Prospective only: fitting, derivation or tuning on a held family's outcomes (or on any remint that peeks at held labels) voids that family's prediction. Retrospective predictions are not predictions. A pre-freeze audit log of which families were used for fitting must be committed and is checked to enforce prospective discipline.
freeze_rule.verification: An auditor can verify freeze by checking (a) timestamp < outcome timestamp, (b) digest matches artifact, (c) remint is bijective (checked by ecology_extension_v1 remint validator), (d) no held-family data appeared in the derivation commit graph (git history acyclicity).

falsifiers_overview: See FALSIFIERS_V1.md. Three cheapest single-command falsifiers are: (Fz1) bijective remint twin swaps predicted grade while D,E,R,H identical; (Fz2) price-vector flip inverts predicted Pareto ordering but predictor does not move; (Fz3) ablation twin removing CONTENT_ROUTED_COMBINATION or halving |S| shows no predicted drop where GG55/GG54 prove a gap. Each is runnable on exact toy microscopes without a large campaign.
evidence_gate: No G6 claim is earned by this skeleton. A G6 claim requires: descriptor enumerability check (P1) + predictor interface check (P1) + per-family frozen predictions + held-family prospective scoring with proper loss + abstention audit + parent subtraction + twin-collapse audit, all before held outcomes.

non_claims: No universal capability scalar or IQ implied
No cross-family transfer proved without held-family test
